Name: (CP) babyvoltage's Emily Pixie Girl (With or Without Wings)
Author: babyvoltage
Description:
This mod changes Emily's sprites (all seasons) and portraits (all seasons) into a CUTE pixie girl.

✋🏻IMPORTANT:
There are 2 versions of portraits and sprites (Vanilla & French Vanilla).
♡ Vanilla - In the style of Stardew Valley
♡ French Vanilla - More in the style of Fields of Mistria (IN PROGRESS)

Included:
♡ NEW outfits for all seasons
♡ NEW wedding dress design
♡ NEW flower dance dress (dirndl)

Credit:
♡ Portrait base by Poltergeister & Jazzybee
